# DemonZ Development

> DemonZ Development is an independent software studio built by seven developers focused on native tools, devtools, open-source libraries, and high-performance systems.

## Overview
- Official Website: https://demonz.org
- Studio Team: Seven core engineers and developers
- Primary Stack: TypeScript, React, Go, Rust, C#, PostgreSQL, Cloudflare Workers
- Headquarters & Admin: https://dzd-hq-9x2m4k.pages.dev

## Core Sections
- Projects & Tools: https://demonz.org/projects
- Technical Articles & Tutorials: https://demonz.org/articles
- Studio Log & Changelogs: https://demonz.org#timeline
- Client Partnerships & Custom Systems: https://demonz.org/partnership

## Software Releases
- NexEU: Native system utilities and desktop tools for creators and developers.
- Free VPS Manager: Cloud infrastructure orchestrator and server monitoring tool.
- Studio Libraries: High-performance packages and open-source engine integrations.

## Agent & AI Integration
- Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server: https://dzd-api.demonzdevelopment.workers.dev/api/mcp
- Transport: Streamable HTTP (JSON-RPC 2.0)
- MCP Authentication: Bearer token or X-MCP-Key header (12-hour session keys generated via admin console)
- Available MCP Tools: dzd_list_projects, dzd_get_project, dzd_list_articles, dzd_get_article, dzd_create_studio_log, dzd_search, dzd_get_stats
